Canton of Lucerne (Luzern) — 瑞士旅遊指南：必去景點、交通方式與在地美食

Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) & Old Town, Lake Lucerne paddle steamers, Mount Pilatus & Mount Rigi excursions, Swiss Museum of Transport (Verkehrshaus). 1 hour by direct SBB InterRegio train from Zurich; GoldenPass Express terminus and Lake Lucerne steamships.

所屬地區 / 州份Canton of Lucerne (Luzern)
主要交通樞紐Lucerne Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)
所有城市與市鎮79

交通方式與當地移動

1 hour by direct SBB InterRegio train from Zurich; GoldenPass Express terminus and Lake Lucerne steamships.

在地美食與特產

  • Luzerner Chügelipastete
  • Alpine cheese fondue
  • Birnenweggen pear pastry
  • Local cider & lake fish
